name: io.github.andreasjhagen/shell-commands
description: MCP server for running Bash shell commands with configurable working directories, timeouts, and output limits

environmentVariables.name: SHELL_COMMANDS_ALLOWED_DIRECTORIES
environmentVariables.description: Path-list of directories permitted as command working directories. Uses the platform path separator (: on Linux/macOS, ; on Windows). Defaults to the current working directory.

environmentVariables.name: SHELL_COMMANDS_SHELL
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the Bash-compatible shell executable. Defaults to /bin/bash, or bash from PATH on Windows.

environmentVariables.name: SHELL_COMMANDS_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Default command timeout in milliseconds (100-3600000). Defaults to 120000.

environmentVariables.name: SHELL_COMMANDS_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum command timeout in milliseconds (100-3600000). Defaults to 600000.

environmentVariables.name: SHELL_COMMANDS_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum captured bytes for each of stdout and stderr (1024-10485760). Defaults to 262144.
